entry.title: more pages, more settings
entry.summary: new pages: a faq, a privacy page, a stack page that counts the tools my projects use, a brand page with the colours and files, a page that lists every page, and a longer ticket form. at the bottom of every page there are now accent and text size buttons, plus a view source link. the stats page shows the pages you opened this visit, and there is another hidden page.

entry.title: support tickets
entry.summary: the contact page has a ticket form now, with a draft that saves while you click around, an id for every ticket, and a report a problem link in the footer. it only starts working once i switch it on, and until then it says so instead of pretending. there is also a feed for these updates now, and the site can be added to a home screen.

entry.title: hidden pages
entry.summary: there are a few hidden things on the site now. good luck finding them. there is also a shortcuts page, for the ones that aren't hidden.

entry.title: more motion
entry.summary: the hero drifts away as you scroll and the footer rises in, page titles wipe in, the first visit of a session has a short intro, buttons ripple, sorting projects slides the cards into place, the back-to-top button shows how far down you are, section headings have copy-link buttons, and each page links to the next and previous one.

entry.title: equalizer, depth and small details
entry.summary: the player has a small equalizer that reacts to the actual music, press k to play or pause, and media keys work. the stars and watermark shift a little as you scroll and move the mouse, the avatar kicks when you click it, gallery images zoom and can be saved, and the updates link gets a dot when there is something new.

entry.title: lighter music file + clearer project cards
entry.summary: the song is about 60% smaller now (2.8 MB instead of 6.9 MB), and it only downloads when it actually starts playing. project cards say whether there is a public repo, and there is a sort button on the projects page.

entry.title: floating nav, toasts and more background
entry.summary: the nav now floats at the top on desktop, there are small popups for things like blocked autoplay, a quick-copy box on the links page, twinkling stars, a slow glow, the odd shooting star, and ♪ in the tab title while music plays.

entry.title: music keeps playing between pages
entry.summary: moving around the site no longer restarts the song. the player can also be minimised, muted with the m key, and remembers that.

entry.title: real profile picture
entry.summary: swapped in my original pencil-rifle picture.
